guide.lightningcraft.cover:
§9by SBlectric§0

§oA Guide to the
World of Lightning!§r
guide.lightningcraft.intro1:
It is said only the very brave or the very stupid mess with one of the most dangerous forces of nature.

For one to harness such raw power, one would need very specialized tools and machines.
guide.lightningcraft.intro2: Lucky for you, you've discovered how to build these machines.
guide.lightningcraft.air_terminals: §lAir Terminals§r - Also known as lightning rods. They act as preferential paths for lightning to take when it strikes the ground. Used to charge lightning cells and use LE.
guide.lightningcraft.cells: §lLightning Cells§r - These store energy from lightning strikes, also known as Lightning Energy (LE). To store the energy of a strike, an air terminal needs to be directly above the lightning cell.
guide.lightningcraft.furnace: §lLightning Furnace§r - A furnace that uses LE instead of solid fuel to smelt items. It smelts much quicker than a normal furnace, using one LE per 2 items burned.
guide.lightningcraft.crusher: §lLightning Crusher§r - A machine that pulverizes items. You can crush gravel into sand, ores to powder, and much more! Great for ore processing and a handy tool in general.
guide.lightningcraft.infuser: §lLightning Infusion Table§r - Takes the idea of using LE to create items to the next level. An item in the center slot gets infused with items in the outer slots along with some LE.
guide.lightningcraft.breaker: §lLightning Block Breaker§r - Uses LE to break the block directly in front of it. The breaker is placed in the same manner as pistons.
guide.lightningcraft.miner: §lLightning Miner§r - Mines blocks in its area. It has 6 modes: 1x1 tunnel, 3x3 tunnel, ores only, logs only, slot matching, and all blocks. Default range is a 16x16x16 cube in front of it, upgradable to 24x24x24.
guide.lightningcraft.generator: §lElectrostatic Generator§r - Generates lightning, and by extension LE, by using blocks to build up a charge. When the charge is full (100C), lightning will strike. It does need a small amount of LE to run.
guide.lightningcraft.rf_export: §lLE to RF Export Bus§r - Converts LE into RF or Tesla so other mods' machines can use it.
guide.lightningcraft.rf_generator: §lRF Lightning Generator§r - Consumes RF or Tesla to generate lightning strikes.
guide.lightningcraft.wireless: §lWireless Power§r - Like Tesla, you've dreamt of wireless power. Today, you've discovered how to implement it. Build one transmitter at your work area and add unlimited receivers nearby. To attune a receiver to the
guide.lightningcraft.wireless2: transmitter, craft a Tx/Rx tag, right-click the transmitter, then shift right-click the receiver. Tags are reusable and can be crafted back into an empty tag if you want to mark a different transmitter.
guide.lightningcraft.reallocator: §lEnchantment Reallocator§r - Pulls enchantments from one item and sticks them onto another. You hypothesize about making such a machine, but you lack the mystical items to do so. Perhaps the answer lies in another realm...
guide.lightningcraft.items_intro: Now that you know the machinery, you should know some of the items and blocks you can create.
guide.lightningcraft.thunderstone: §lThunderstone§r - A mysterious dense stone birthed from the depths of the earth. It seems to have semi-liquid properties and resists wear and tear. Four can be made with 4 cobblestone, 4 quartz, and a block of obsidian.
guide.lightningcraft.electricium: §lElectricium§r - Iron and gold are nice, but you've discovered how to create a metal better than each of them. Electricium has impressive electrical properties too. Made by infusing iron with gold, diamond and LE, or by striking them with lightning.
guide.lightningcraft.useful_items:
Other Useful Items:

There are many useful things you can make with infusion, like diamonds from coal or sponges from wool and slimeballs. All infusion recipes can be found in JEI and in the index.
guide.lightningcraft.tools_intro: You've also discovered how to make new tools and armor.
guide.lightningcraft.elec_tools: §lElectricium Tools§r - Stronger, faster and more enchantable than vanilla tools, but quite a bit more expensive. Made with electricium rods and ingots.
guide.lightningcraft.elec_weapons: §lElectricium Weapons§r - Quite powerful indeed. The sword and hammer deal 9 and 10 attack damage respectively, and have latent electrical properties that can be brought out by the Hand of Thor enchantment.
guide.lightningcraft.elec_armor: §lElectricium Armor§r - Slightly more protection than diamond armor and more durable. Has latent electrical properties that can be brought out by the Electrostatic Aura enchantment.
guide.lightningcraft.stonebound: §lStonebound Swords§r - Stone doesn't channel LE very well, but by forcing LE through it you can bind materials to it. Infusing stone swords with various materials could have some interesting effects...
guide.lightningcraft.mobile_le: §lMobile LE§r - Through your tinkering with electricium, you found that combined with redstone it forms a primitive voltaic pile. By stabilizing this pile with iron rods and a comparator, you made a functional battery capable of storing a
guide.lightningcraft.mobile_le2: small amount of LE. This battery can be charged from a lightning cell via a charging plate. When charged, it gives you a source of mobile LE in your inventory. It may just come in handy!
guide.lightningcraft.kinetics: §lKinetics§r - An interesting new field of research. By crafting a golden tool or piece of armor with redstone and an electricium plate, somewhat like making a battery, the electrical properties of the gold can be
guide.lightningcraft.kinetics2: brought out. Give these kinetic devices a mobile source of raw power - lightning, perhaps? - and their abilities are amplified many times over: a kinetic sword is over twice as powerful as a golden one, for example. Tools mine
guide.lightningcraft.kinetics3: many times faster. Armor makes you invincible. No feat seems out of reach now. You have even designed other trinkets that use mobile LE to achieve neat functionalities.
guide.lightningcraft.mind_turns: Your mind turns to electricium. "Sure, it's great!" you say, but at the same time you wonder if there is a material that offers more...
guide.lightningcraft.what_if: What if... what if you were to infuse electricium... with thunderstone... and um... eyes of ender? Surely doing that wouldn't be taboo...!
guide.lightningcraft.skyfather1: Your intuition was right. The Skyfather ingot is powerful indeed. You can make divine tools and armor out of this new material. Tools made this way have special properties, and both tools and armor repair themselves automatically.
guide.lightningcraft.skyfather2:
You can also make Lightning Upgrades by crafting a shard with four redstone, which improves various machinery when right-clicked.
The Skyfather Shard is useful, but the gods have taken notice of your mortal insolence. Demon Soldiers will now attack on sight.
guide.lightningcraft.skyfather3: If you were to kill these demons, legend has it you can use their blood to forge a portal to the Underworld...
guide.lightningcraft.skyfather4: Perhaps even Skyfather stuff can be upgraded...
guide.lightningcraft.underworld1: You've made your portal to the Underworld. What you see is a vast, dark and damp cavern filled with spiders, demons and more. It is so dark that night vision completely fails.
guide.lightningcraft.structures_intro: There are a few naturally generated structures in this evil dimension.
guide.lightningcraft.water_temples: §lWater Temples§r - These seemingly serene temples spawn in the bottom ocean of the Underworld.
guide.lightningcraft.towers: §lUnderworld Towers§r - These monolithic structures, found at nearly any height, are home to the Skeletal Guards. The top rooms hold untold treasures. The guards drop their bones, which can be used to create high tier items.
guide.lightningcraft.ramparts: §lStalactite Ramparts§r - These garrisons spawn at the top of the Underworld, with cannons aimed at anyone foolish enough to breach their walls. They also contain divine treasures, including the legendary Ichor.
guide.lightningcraft.mobs: §lMobs§r - Aside from demons and the mobs mentioned above, Deadly Undercreeps and Underghasts roam the dark expanses of the Underworld. They drop Underpowder when killed, which can be used to make extremely powerful TNT.
guide.lightningcraft.warding1: Demons have been attacking you on sight for some time now. You've made a potion that can do away with that: infuse a mundane potion with 2 demon blood and 2 golden carrots for a brew that keeps demons at bay.
guide.lightningcraft.warding2: If they're already chasing you it won't stop them, and it won't stop them from retaliating when you strike them. But it is certainly better than being attacked for no reason.
guide.lightningcraft.warding3: This potion can be brewed into splash and lingering varieties, and used to make tipped arrows. Demons probably won't enjoy being under the demon warding effect...
